grammar.summary: 本课学习表"史无前例之最"的 no other 结构。

points.title: no other.../nothing...so...as
points.explanation: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time. of all time = 有史以来，最高级语域。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings.
examples.cn: 水晶宫与所有其他建筑都不同。

points.title: on display 表展出
points.explanation: goods from all over the world were on display. on display/on show = 展出中，介词短语作表语。

examples.en: It was visited by millions of people.

exercises.q: While the guard was ___, he heard a shot.
I've changed my mind. ___ I' go by plane instead.
You must not, ___, leave this room.
I'm not always pleased with his work, but ___ it is satisfactory.
